the temperature dependence of heavy quarkonium correlator is not a direct measure of quarkonium spectral function, but it is rather a measure of the effective heavy quark mass.
the low energy modes dominate the quarkonium correlator and that they can be well described by a simple model with a temperature-dependent mass.
